# #142 - Boozt, H&M och Skistar – tre temperaturmätare på svenska konsumenten?

**Feed**: montrosepodden  
**Published**: 2026-10-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Montrose hosts (Niklas and Viktor) cover macro conditions first: the US 10-year yield has passed 5%, market breadth is narrow in both the US and Stockholm, oil flows through Hormuz are recovering and the fourth quarter has historically been strong. Turning to the Q3 reporting season, they compare H&M's weak September sales (+1% growth, cautious guidance) with Boozt's positive profit warning and raised full-year guidance. They see a weaker krona as a tailwind for exporters, and the transcript cuts off just as Skistar is being discussed.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 BOOZT — Boozt | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Positive profit warning and raised full-year guidance on lasting momentum; insiders have well-timed trades.

#### Reasoning

Boozt raised full-year guidance on strong momentum and helpful weather, unlike H&M. Household confidence is at a ~5-year high and retail sentiment is above normal. Insiders have timed trades well, but the hosts explicitly say not to buy just because of that, and fashion hit-or-miss risk applies to the whole sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a collection misses (Nelly-style fashion risk)
- if household confidence turns down
- if insiders keep selling at highs

> *"de kommer ju med en omvänd vinstvarning på måndagskvällen och höjd helårsguiding"*

---

### ⛔ HM-B — H&M | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

1% September growth, cautious Q3 guidance, fading margin tailwind; failing to benefit from improving consumer sentiment.

#### Reasoning

Even with low expectations, growth disappointed and guidance was cautious. Margin tailwinds are fading as costs (e.g. transport) rise. The brand has weak positioning against Inditex, Uniqlo and Lindex, lags in e-commerce and stands out negatively while consumer confidence improves. Downside is limited as a 'supertanker', and buybacks provide support.

#### Sell Triggers

- reverse if sales growth clearly accelerates
- if positioning/e-commerce improves

> *"tillväxten var ändå lite av en besvikelse. Det tar inte fart."*

---

### 🟡 INVE-B — Investor | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

CEO insider buy after a ~5% dip; described as a core holding that has beaten all Sweden funds over 3-20 years.

#### Reasoning

The host sees Investor as a long-term core holding with an outstanding track record and some 750,000 shareholders. The CEO bought after a modest dip. The host says it is not necessarily the best short-term buy but a solid base holding to add to.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the long-term track record against Sweden funds breaks
- if the discount/premium to net asset value moves sharply against holders

> *"Det är ett bra basinnehav. Många äger den."*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Buys in USD with costs in SEK; FX and a weaker consumer could weigh on results.

#### Reasoning

The company has performed very well, but a currency shift could become a headwind for importers like Clas Ohlson, especially if consumers weaken. Speculative comment only.

#### Sell Triggers

- if FX hurts gross margin in reports
- if consumer demand weakens

> *"De köper ju in mycket i dollar och har ju kostnaderna i svenska kronor. Där kan det bli jobbigt"*

---

### 🟠 SKIS-B — Skistar | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

A weaker krona could draw foreign tourists; host praises the CEO's year-round strategy.

#### Reasoning

The hosts argue a weaker SEK makes Swedish holidays cheaper for foreigners, though the CEO stresses snow conditions matter more. The host speaks positively of CEO Stefan Sjöstrand's execution. The transcript is cut off before any conclusion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if snow conditions are poor
- if the krona strengthens

> *"Skistar, också skulle kunna gynnas när kronan blir lite svagare"*

---

### 🟠 LEN — Lennar | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Berkshire is building a stake quickly; the stock has halved from its peak and looks like a bet that rates have peaked.

#### Reasoning

Hosts find it interesting as a contrarian idea: Berkshire is buying a housebuilder while mortgage rates are above 7%, after the valuation has fallen a lot. It is a cited observation rather than the hosts' own view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if long rates keep rising
- if the US housing market stays frozen

> *"det låter som ett rent play på just att räntorna kanske börjar toppa på de här nivåerna"*

---
